metadata.description: Execute a batch read operation on the webhooks journal for the specified date, 2026-03.
metadata.learn_more: Execute a batch read operation on the webhooks journal for the specified date, 2026-03. This endpoint allows you to retrieve multiple entries from the webhooks journal in a single request, which can be useful for processing large amounts of data efficiently. Ensure that the request body is provided in the required format.

installPortalId.label: Install Portal Id
installPortalId.description: An integer representing the ID of the portal installation for which the webhooks journal data should be retrieved.

inputs.label: Inputs
inputs.description: An array of strings that are to be processed in the batch operation. This property is required.
